method: Read candidate test, actual bootstrap/relay/hook/document-capture/replay source, mutation report and resource journals. No tests, native run, build, release, database access or secret access performed.

verdict_a_coverage_scope.finding: The test mounts the actual useNetworkCapture hook, registers real bootstrapBackground handlers, executes networkRelayIsolated, and feeds the actual startDocumentNetworkCapture CDP listener through controlled Chrome doubles. A manual response is relayed and appears in the hook before Page.reload is released; the saved replay yields the current CDP row, then a second distinct current row. This covers manual-channel contamination of saved replay without duplicating production routing in the test.
limits: The manual page event and CDP callbacks are synthetic browser-boundary inputs; this is source coverage, not native or public-site acceptance.
It does not independently test a prior-document CDP binding callback, stale-only recovery, or the full EXT-D-0047/T57 case.

verdict_b_quality_evidence.finding: The proposed constant-output mutant necessarily fails the test's Page.reload orchestration check; this is a meaningful gut check against bypassing the SUT, although it does not reach the distinct second-row assertion. The production-owned channel-mix mutant subscribes the replay collector to the actual manual NET_CAPTURE_EVENT and stamps replay identity; manual request_sequence 999 then outranks current CDP sequence 1. The recorded RED at the saved-row assertion is causally plausible and targets the intended invariant. Resource journals corroborate admitted child exits 1/1/0 for constant, channel-mix and untouched source, with resourceInvalid false. Current shared test and run-interactive SHA-256 match the report's untouched hashes. The refused first channel launch has no test verdict.
verdict_b_quality_evidence.important_limit: The committed journals record admission and child exit codes but not Vitest stdout/stderr or source hashes per run. The exact failure assertions and mutant contents are recorded in the implementer's JSON; the scratch directory is absent, so this peer cannot independently tie the asserted mutation bytes and failure lines to each child run. Preserve a bounded test transcript and per-run mutant source hash if independent proof of those exact outcomes is required. No fresh test was allowed in this review.

closure: Accept as a bounded source guard with qualified mutation evidence. Do not promote this review to native/full D47 or T57 verification.
